prohibited_generalizations: Do not reorder USA, SWE, and CHN in this sentence.

units.source_excerpt: In this regard, we made the following recommendations:
units.function: Open a recommendation list with In this regard.
units.reusable_pattern: Write In this regard, we made the following recommendations:
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace In this regard with Therefore.

units.source_excerpt: For the USA NOC, we suggested hiring a great coach for Rowing, Fencing, and Canoeing. With the influence of a great coach, these sports are expected to add 0.8 medals to the medal table.
units.function: Recommend sports, then give a fractional medal gain.
units.reusable_pattern: Write For the [NOC], we suggested hiring a great coach for [sports]. With the influence of a great coach, these sports are expected to add [value] medals to the medal table.
reusable_elements: For the USA NOC, we suggested
With the influence of a great coach
prohibited_generalizations: Do not round 0.8 to 1.

units.source_excerpt: For the SWE NOC, we recommended hiring a great coach for Table Tennis, expecting an increase of 0.9 medals in the medal table.
units.function: Change the recommendation verb and close with a participle.
units.reusable_pattern: Write For the [NOC], we recommended hiring a great coach for [sport], expecting an increase of [value] medals.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not change recommended back to suggested.

units.source_excerpt: For the CHN NOC, we advised hiring a great coach for Football, expecting an increase of 1 medal in the medal table.
units.function: Change the verb again and keep 1 as a digit.
units.reusable_pattern: Write For the [NOC], we advised hiring a great coach for [sport], expecting an increase of [digit] medal.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not write one for 1, and do not add an -s to medal.

units.source_excerpt: In conclusion, these changes demonstrate that our model effectively captures potential scenarios involving the coach, analyzes the changes it brings to the variables, and incorporates these changes back into the model, which led to the expected impact of the coach on the medal count.
units.function: Close a result section by sending the changes back into the model.
units.reusable_pattern: Write In conclusion, these changes demonstrate that our model effectively captures, analyzes, and incorporates these changes back into the model, which led to.
reusable_elements: incorporates these changes back into the model
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop the which-clause.

units.source_excerpt: In this section, we will focus on original insights that were not addressed in the task but were proposed through the analysis of our model results. Based on these original insights, we will also provide effective recommendations for the Olympic Committees of the relevant countries.
units.function: Define an insight section as not addressed in the task.
units.reusable_pattern: Write In this section, we will focus on [insights] that were not addressed in the task but were proposed through the analysis of our model results. Based on these [insights], we will also provide effective recommendations for.
reusable_elements: that were not addressed in the task
prohibited_generalizations: Do not repair the heading Oringinal in this sentence.

units.source_excerpt: Based on Section 6.2, our model identified several events in which countries that have never won medals are most likely to win. It also quantitatively shows the contribution of the coach effect to a country's medal count.
units.function: Point a recommendation back at a section number.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Based on Section N, our model identified. It also quantitatively shows.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a number the sentence does not give.

units.source_excerpt: This means that for countries that have never won a medal, hiring an excellent coach for the most likely events can significantly increase the probability of winning a medal.
units.function: Turn a model result into a hiring recommendation with This means that.
units.reusable_pattern: Write This means that for [group], [action] can significantly increase the probability of [outcome].
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace excellent coach with great coach.

units.source_excerpt: To investigate this specific impact, we applied our model to two NOCs that have never won any medals before: BEN NOC and BOL NOC.
units.function: Apply the model to named never-won committees.
units.reusable_pattern: Write To investigate this specific impact, we applied our model to [number] [units] that have never won any medals before: [names].
reusable_elements: that have never won any medals before
prohibited_generalizations: Do not expand BEN or BOL.

units.source_excerpt: Based on this, we suggest that BEN NOC and BOL NOC should adopt our model and hire Great Coaches for Swimming Men's 50m Freestyle and Athletics Women's 20km Race Walk respectively, in order to pursue their first historical medals.
units.function: Pair two events with respectively and a capital Great Coaches.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Based on this, we suggest that [names] should adopt our model and hire [coaches] for [event] and [event] respectively, in order to pursue.
reusable_elements: Based on this, we suggest that
should adopt our model and hire
prohibited_generalizations: Do not lowercase Great Coaches, and do not swap the events.

units.source_excerpt: Moreover, we recommend that the Olympic Committees of countries that have not yet won medals refer to our model and, taking their own strengths into account, look for excellent coaches in specific events to increase the probability of winning their first medal.
units.function: Widen a two-country suggestion with Moreover and an inserted participle.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Moreover, we recommend that [audience] refer to our model and, taking their own strengths into account, look for.
reusable_elements: taking their own strengths into account
prohibited_generalizations: Do not move the participle to the end.

units.source_excerpt: We also found that experienced athletes in certain events in specific countries have a significant impact on the overall level, which in turn influences the total medal count.
units.function: Add a second insight with We also found that and which in turn.
units.reusable_pattern: Write We also found that [group] have a significant impact on [level], which in turn influences [count].
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop which in turn.

units.source_excerpt: Our model measures the country's event performance level in the sport using the Trueskill system, where the experience of athletes influences the level.
units.function: Name the rating system in a third spelling.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Our model measures [level] using the Trueskill system, where [factor] influences the level.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not rewrite Trueskill as TrueSkill.

units.source_excerpt: Below are the overall medal statistics for USA NOC in the Fencing Men's Foil Team, the proportion of veteran athletes, and the level changes. These changes are shown in Figure 21 below:
units.function: List three plotted series, then point at the figure.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Below are [three series]. These changes are shown in Figure N below:
reusable_elements: These changes are shown in Figure
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop one of the three series.

units.source_excerpt: This means that for USA NOC in the Fencing Men's Foil Team, having more experienced athletes participating in the event may increase the likelihood of winning a medal, compared to sending more new athletes.
units.function: Turn a figure into a may-increase comparison.
units.reusable_pattern: Write This means that for [case], [action] may increase the likelihood of [outcome], compared to [alternative].
reusable_elements: compared to sending more new athletes
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop may or compared to.

units.source_excerpt: Therefore, we suggest that the Olympic Committees of different countries use our model to analyze past event performance and, based on the analysis, send more experienced athletes to the competition to improve their chances of winning medals.
units.function: Widen one example with Therefore, we suggest that, and insert a based-on phrase.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Therefore, we suggest that [audience] use our model to analyze and, based on the analysis, [action] to improve.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not move based on the analysis to the front.

units.source_excerpt: We innovatively employed a variety of methods to comprehensively integrate as much useful information as possible, achieving a relatively high prediction accuracy.
units.function: Claim a strength with innovatively employed and a participle.
units.reusable_pattern: Write We innovatively employed a variety of methods to comprehensively integrate as much useful information as possible, achieving a relatively high prediction accuracy.
reusable_elements: as much useful information as possible
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace relatively high with a score.

units.source_excerpt: Compared to directly predicting using medal counts, the model compensate for missing cases.
units.function: Contrast a rejected method and keep the missing verb ending.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Compared to [rejected method], the model compensate for [gap].
reusable_elements: the model compensate for missing cases
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add -s to compensate.

units.source_excerpt: When a country doesn't participate in an event in a certain year, its level doesn't reset to zero and can still be used in subsequent predictions.
units.function: State a missing-year rule with two contractions.
units.reusable_pattern: Write When a [unit] doesn't [act], its [level] doesn't reset to zero and can still be used in subsequent predictions.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not expand doesn't.

units.source_excerpt: We innovatively proposed the LR-SCAD model to accurately measure the coaching effect, which holds significant guiding value for Olympic competitions. To ensure accuracy, a relatively large amount of computation is inevitably required. In the future, we can further optimize the model to reduce the computational cost.
units.function: Close strengths, then give one weakness and a future repair.
units.reusable_pattern: Write We innovatively proposed [model] to accurately measure, which holds significant guiding value. To ensure accuracy, [cost] is inevitably required. In the future, we can further optimize the model to reduce the computational cost.
reusable_elements: In the future, we can further optimize
prohibited_generalizations: Do not add a second weakness.

units.source_excerpt: In the sensitivity analysis, we selected two hyperparameters from the TrueSkill model and two from the SARIMAX model that significantly influence the results. The following Figure 22 illustrates the variation in final medal prediction accuracy with changes in sigma and beta for TrueSkill, as well as p and q for SARIMAX, within a specified range.
units.function: Announce a sensitivity test by counting hyperparameters and naming the figure.
units.reusable_pattern: Write In the sensitivity analysis, we selected [number] hyperparameters from [model] and [number] from [model] that significantly influence the results. The following Figure N illustrates the variation in [outcome] with changes in [names], within a specified range.
reusable_elements: In the sensitivity analysis, we selected
prohibited_generalizations: Do not invent the specified range.

units.source_excerpt: It can be observed that when sigma and beta change, the prediction accuracy remains relatively stable overall, demonstrating the strong robustness of our model. This is because TrueSkill's influence on the level of each event is nearly uniform. However, prediction accuracy exhibits slightly larger fluctuations with changes in p and q.
units.function: Split a stable pair from a less stable pair with However.
units.reusable_pattern: Write It can be observed that when [pair] change, [outcome] remains relatively stable overall, demonstrating. This is because. However, [outcome] exhibits slightly larger fluctuations with changes in [other pair].
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop slightly.

features.transition: This is because these two follows

units.source_excerpt: This is because these two hyperparameters directly affect the prediction outcomes.
units.function: Give the reason for the larger fluctuation in a short because-sentence.
units.reusable_pattern: Write This is because [items] directly affect the prediction outcomes.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not merge this reason into the previous sentence.

units.source_excerpt: The Following Figure 23 shows that as the average number of samples used for time series prediction decreases, the final prediction accuracy initially tends to decline.
units.function: Capitalize Following and hedge the decline with initially tends to.
units.reusable_pattern: Write The Following Figure N shows that as [input] decreases, [outcome] initially tends to decline.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not lowercase Following.

units.source_excerpt: However, after a certain point, the downward trend slows. This is because our model automatically transitions to a simple linear regression prediction when there is less time series data, thereby avoiding larger errors introduced by time series forecasting. As a result, our model demonstrates strong adaptability across different datasets.
units.function: Turn a decline into a fallback and close with As a result.
units.reusable_pattern: Write However, after a certain point, [trend] slows. This is because our model automatically transitions to [fallback] when, thereby avoiding. As a result, our model demonstrates.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not name the certain point.

units.source_excerpt: For Task 1, we built a bottom-up medal analysis and prediction model using the TrueSkill-SARIMAX-RF method.
units.function: Return in the conclusion to the summary's model name.
units.reusable_pattern: Write For Task N, we built a bottom-up [summary name] using the [hyphenated method].
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace analysis and prediction with the Our Work word projection.

units.source_excerpt: The results from these two parts of events are aggregated to form the final medal count model for each country.
units.function: Restore of events in the conclusion aggregation sentence.
units.reusable_pattern: Write The results from these two parts of events are aggregated to form the final medal count model for each country.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not drop of events to match Our Work.

units.source_excerpt: For Task 2, we performed residual analysis to find evidence of how coaches influence athletes' performance and medal counts. By analyzing different variables, we identified anomaly information in the data, providing evidence of how the "great coach" effect alters the data.
units.function: Repeat the summary's anomaly-information sentence in the conclusion.
units.reusable_pattern: Write For Task N, we performed residual analysis to find evidence. By analyzing different variables, we identified anomaly information, providing evidence of how.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not replace anomaly information with the Our Work word outliers.

units.source_excerpt: Subsequently, we studied how the "great coach" effect contributed to changes in the total medal count for different countries and created visualizations for this.
units.function: Drop the model name in the conclusion and keep Subsequently.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Subsequently, we studied how [effect] contributed to changes, and created visualizations for this.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not restore introduced LR-SCAD model from the summary.

units.source_excerpt: Finally, we selected USA NOC , SWE NOC , and CHN NOC and identified the sports in which these countries should invest in a great coach.
units.function: Restore the summary's NOC list, spaces and all.
units.reusable_pattern: Write Finally, we selected USA NOC , SWE NOC , and CHN NOC, with a space before each comma.
reusable_elements: should invest in a great coach
prohibited_generalizations: Do not delete the space, and do not use the Our Work order.

units.source_excerpt: For Task 3, based on the model, we analyzed and derived 2 factors that affect a country's medal count, which were not covered in Tasks 1 and 2. These factors were then integrated into insights and explained how these insights could provide valuable reference for national Olympic committees.
units.function: Restore the digit 2 and switch useful reference to valuable reference.
units.reusable_pattern: Write For Task N, based on the model, we analyzed and derived [digit] factors. These factors were then integrated into insights and explained how these insights could provide valuable reference for.
prohibited_generalizations: Do not write two, and do not restore useful.
